headline: US Terminates South Africa and Rwanda AGOA Trade Benefits
summary: The United States has moved to terminate South Africa and Rwanda's eligibility for the African Growth and Opportunity Act, ending preferential access to the U.S. market from January 1, 2027.
why: AGOA provides duty-free access to the United States for qualifying sub-Saharan African nations, supporting regional export industries and economic development. Loss of eligibility can significantly impact bilateral trade flows and local manufacturing sectors.

impacts.name: South Africa
impacts.why: Termination of AGOA eligibility removes preferential tariff access to the US market for South African goods.
